name: Modern townhouse row (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Terrace of three three-storey townhouses, 27.6 x 11 m: each unit in its own finish (brick slip, white render with timber cladding, grey brick), floor-to-ceiling first-floor windows with glass Juliet balconies, a steel door canopy, a parapet roof. Enterable: every unit has a kitchen-diner, a first-floor living room and a top-floor bedroom off a landing corridor with two stairs.
